posts: New: Browser check. Press a button and see what the scripts of any web page can read about your browser, explained in plain words, with what you can do about each detail. It runs in your browser: nothing is sent or stored. https://joseasenjo.github.io/tracker-watch/go/check/ #privacy #adtech #GDPR
alt_text: Screenshot of the Browser check page on the Tracker Watch website. It shows two optional checks, each with an explanation and a button: 'Are trackers blocked? An optional test' with the button 'Run the tracker test', and 'What does your connection reveal? Another optional check' with the button 'Check my connection'. Below them starts the section 'How to read the report'.
